spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §3 (framing: length == 0 -> Error(401)+Close(401), before any allocation)
description: Framing violation: a length prefix of 0 declares a zero-length Frame — refused before allocation.
preconditions: State machine: CONNECTING (any state behaves identically; nothing decodes).

steps.note: Length prefix declares 0 bytes of Frame.

assertions: The length check runs before any allocation and before any parse (spec §3).
No request_id can be known — the Error is unsolicited (0, not encoded).
Fatal: Error+Close with the same code, then the transport close carries 401.
